Step two — let it scan. It reads the page, not the network.
Step three — preview and pick

Step five — download. That is the whole job.

title: Why an online SVG extractor cannot see this page
captions: An online tool only gets the URL you paste
It never runs the page, so inline icons stay invisible
An extension runs inside the page you are already on
Logged-in pages and private dashboards included
And nothing leaves your machine to make it work
